ABOUT MUVESIC

Movement becomes music.

A little guidance.
A world of sound to explore.

Muvesic is a musical playground you control with your hands. Use your webcam, or try a mouse, touch, or keyboard. Start with these three simple movements.

01 / PITCH

Reach for the high notes.

Your fingertip moves through a scale. Higher hand, higher note.

02 / SPACE

Let the sound wander.

Move left and right to shift the sound between your ears. Try headphones.

03 / FEEL

Put a little energy into it.

Move gently for softer notes. Sweep faster to give your melody more feeling.

Start making music ↗
